encoding_notes: Live page is Cloudflare-protected + JS SPA ('Loading...' shell to non-browser fetchers); encoded from a headless real-browser render of the current guide.

Canonical guide moved to journals.bioscientifica.com/eor/pages/author-guidelines; the older eor.bioscientifica.com/page/author/author-guidelines redirects to the Bioscientifica portal. Journal still published by Bioscientifica (2026 articles carry DOI prefix 10.1530); ScienceDirect/Elsevier only mirrors the content.

Review journal: two named author types. 'Review Articles' (explicitly 'narrative, instructional Review Articles') -> review + narrative_review; 'Systematic Reviews' (incl. meta-analyses, PRISMA-governed) -> systematic_review. No original research / case reports / letters accepted.

Two abstract formats: Review Articles = 3-6 bullet points, max 250 words (unstructured); Systematic Reviews = structured Purpose/Methods/Results/Conclusions, max 250 words. The abstract object encodes the primary (Review Article) format.
4000-word recommendation is stated for 'Review articles'; Systematic Reviews are described as 'more extensive' with no stated word cap -> systematic_review manuscript_max_words left null.
Tiered figure DPI: images (JPEG/TIFF) >=300 dpi; line art (EPS) >=800 dpi. min_dpi set to 300 (images); 800 dpi line-art tier does not fit the single-DPI schema field.
Default license CC-BY-NC 4.0; CC-BY or CC-BY-NC-ND accommodated on funder request.

In-text citation marker format (superscript vs bracket) not stated in the guide; only 'Vancouver system, numbered by order of citation' is stated. in_text left null rather than inferred from house style.
Reference journal names are abbreviated (NLM-style, e.g. 'Bone Joint J'); no DOIs shown in the Vancouver reference examples -> include_doi false.

scrub_metadata set true inferred from the double-anonymous requirement that 'the rest of the article should not contain any identifying information'; file-property scrubbing is not called out verbatim.
Table caption_position 'above' and numbering 'arabic' inferred from 'each table should have a short, descriptive heading' + 'numbered consecutively'; numeral type/position not stated verbatim.
PRISMA checklist required for Systematic Reviews; PROSPERO registration encouraged (number kept out of the anonymized manuscript). ICMJE conflict-of-interest form required from every author.
Cover letter required (must state prior-publication/CoI; PROSPERO number for systematic reviews).
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'bracket' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'vancouver').
[schema-required default] title_page.elements: dropped non-title-page value(s) ['author_contributions'] (not in the schema enum).
